item.title: Insights from AusBiotech 2019 and Pharmaceutical Machinery Innovations
item.description:
Insights from AusBiotech 2019 and Pharmaceutical Machinery Innovations
#

Every year, AusBiotech serves as a pivotal gathering point for leaders and stakeholders in the Australian and international biotechnology sectors. The 2019 conference, held in Melbourne from October 30 to November 1 at the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre (MCEC), provided three days dedicated to education, skill development, and networking. This event is recognized for fostering reflection on industry achievements and facilitating the exchange of ideas to propel the sector forward both nationally and globally.

item.title: Industry Opportunities at Korea's Leading Cosmetic, Pharmaceutical, and Bio Exhibition
item.description:
Exploring COPHEX 2020: A Hub for Cosmetic, Pharmaceutical, and Bio Process Technology
#

COPHEX stands as Korea’s largest exhibition dedicated to the cosmetic, pharmaceutical, and bio manufacturing sectors. This event brings together leading manufacturers, suppliers, and industry specialists from across the globe, offering a dynamic environment for networking, knowledge exchange, and business development.

item.title: Opportunities and Innovations in Japan's Pharmaceutical Machinery Market
item.description:
Opportunities and Innovations in Japan’s Pharmaceutical Machinery Market
#

CPhI Japan is recognized as a premier international event for the pharmaceutical and medical industries, bringing together over 20,000 professionals from more than 65 countries each year. The event serves as a dynamic platform for networking, discovering business opportunities, and exploring the latest advancements in pharmaceutical technology and solutions.
